tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Screen background (parchment in light, deep teal night in dark).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, bottom bar.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs, meter tracks, chips, the Hudhud note strip.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines (decorative, not for controls).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body and headings on bg, surface and sunken.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and control borders on bg, surface and sunken.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Terracotta. Primary button, Dil choice, selected states.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Terracotta text and links on bg and surface.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Teal. Secondary button, Duniya choice, info.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on secondary.

tokens.name: secondary-text
tokens.usage: Teal text, 'strong fit' labels on bg and surface.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Saffron. Highlights only: new dots, celebration, the mascot's crown. Never a text colour.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on bg and surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and icons on bg and surface.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid, 2px offset.

tokens.name: logo-twig
tokens.usage: Branch logo stem and twig. Adapts per background (see Logo).

tokens.name: logo-leaf
tokens.usage: Branch logo leaves and dots.

tokens.name: mascot-body
tokens.usage: Hudhud body and crest. Brighter on dark so it does not sink.

tokens.name: mascot-ink
tokens.usage: Hudhud wing, beak, tail, legs, crest tips. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: mascot-light
tokens.usage: Hudhud wing bars, tail band, belly.

tokens.name: mascot-outline
tokens.usage: 1.5px die-cut edge around Hudhud on dark grounds only.

color.contrastNote: High contrast: every text token >= 7:1 on bg, surface and sunken; control borders and focus >= 3:1 (measured 7.4-21:1). accent stays decorative only and always carries a 3:1 outline or a text label.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Blueprint reveals, onboarding hero. One per screen.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Short titles and card titles only (not paragraphs). Scene narration uses body-l.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Every choice tells us something. None of them is wrong.
styles.usage: Choice text, scene narration and all reading text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Small caps labels, meta. Minimum size.

styles.name: urdu-body-l
styles.usage: Urdu reading text, scene narration, parent report body.

styles.name: urdu-label
styles.usage: Urdu buttons, tabs, chips. Minimum Urdu size (Nastaliq reads smaller than Latin at the same px).

styles.name: reading-body
styles.usage: Replaces body-l and body when the reading-font setting is on (FR-97). Latin only; Urdu keeps Gulzar.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips, between stacked labels.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter, card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between sections in a screen.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Top of screen to title, big breaks.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, meter segments, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, choice cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets, Blueprint slides.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Avatar, toggles.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Raised cards on bg in light mode; dark mode uses border instead.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of every tappable control.

tokens.name: screen-gutter
tokens.usage: Left and right padding of every phone screen.

tokens.name: bp-compact
tokens.usage: Small phones under 360px (older Androids). Single column, 16px gutter, scale display type down one step.

tokens.name: bp-phone
tokens.usage: Most phones 360–599px. Single column, 16px gutter, bottom tab bar.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: Tablets and foldables 600–1023px. Content max 640px centred, 24px gutter, two-column cards where useful.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: Web dashboard for teachers and schools, 1024px and up. Side navigation, 12-column grid, content max 1200px.
